rows.corpus_definition: Someone who buys and sells goods for profit.
rows.example_en: The merchant sold spices at the busy market.

rows.corpus_definition: The quality of being good and deserving of praise.
rows.example_en: Your suggestion has a lot of merit.

rows.corpus_definition: The very center point of a group or an area.
rows.example_en: She stood in the midst of the noisy crowd.

rows.corpus_definition: A very small version of something larger.
rows.example_en: She keeps a tiny model of a house on her shelf.

rows.corpus_definition: behavior that is playful but may cause small problems
rows.example_en: The children were full of mischief today.

rows.corpus_definition: A state of being extremely unhappy or having great pain.
rows.example_en: War brings great misery to all people involved.

rows.corpus_definition: A period of bad luck or an unlucky event.
rows.example_en: She had the misfortune to lose her wallet.

rows.corpus_definition: The quality of doing things within reasonable limits.
rows.example_en: Everything should be enjoyed in moderation.

rows.corpus_definition: Shared or felt by two or more people together.
rows.example_en: They share a mutual interest in music.

rows.corpus_definition: To take care of someone or something while growing.
rows.example_en: Teachers help to nurture the talent of young students.
